stories.title: Sharing My Toys
stories.learningGoal: Learning to wait for a turn to play with a favorite toy, and using a timer to help the waiting feel easier.

pages.text: This is Leo. Leo loves playing with his red train.
First, a friend asks for a turn with the train.
Leo feels his hands squeeze tight. He wants to keep playing.
It is hard to wait. That is okay.
First, we set a little visual timer.
Then, I count to five slowly while the friend plays.
The timer goes ding! It is Leo's turn again.
I did it. I shared and waited for my turn.

copingCards.title: Count to five
steps: Hold up one hand with all five fingers.
Put one finger down and say one.
Put the next finger down and say two.
Keep counting slowly until all fingers are down.
